# langsmith_alert_rule (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith project alert rule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) Alert delivery actions. Use `url_env` for webhook URLs so they are sent to LangSmith without being stored in Terraform state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `aggregation` (String) Metric aggregation, such as `avg`, `sum`, or `pct`.
- `attribute` (String) Metric attribute to monitor.
- `description` (String) Alert rule description.
- `name` (String) Alert rule name.
- `operator` (String) Comparison operator.
- `session_id` (String) LangSmith tracing project/session ID.
- `type` (String) Alert rule type, such as `threshold` or `change`.
- `window_minutes` (Number) Evaluation window in minutes.

### Optional

- `denominator_filter` (String) Denominator filter for percentage aggregations.
- `filter` (String) Run filter expression.
- `threshold` (Number) Threshold for threshold alert rules.
- `threshold_multiplier` (Number) Multiplier for change alert rules.
- `threshold_window_minutes` (Number) Comparison window for change alert rules.
- `workspace_id` (String) LangSmith workspace (tenant) ID that owns this rule. When unset, the resource uses the workspace configured on the provider block.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Alert rule ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `target` (String) Action target: `webhook`, `pagerduty`, or `dynatrace`.

Optional:

- `config_json` (String) JSON-encoded action config.
- `url_env` (String) Environment variable containing a webhook URL. The value is sent to LangSmith but not stored in Terraform state.
